question: How many orders have been delivered?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_status = 'delivered';

question: How many orders were delivered late?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date;

question: Who is the top seller by revenue?
sql: SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS total_revenue FROM olist_order_items_dataset GROUP BY seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which product categories have the highest late-delivery rate?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS late_rate FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY late_rate DESC;

question: Which states have the longest average delivery time?
sql: SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_delivery_time FROM olist_orders_dataset o JOIN olist_customers_dataset c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY avg_delivery_time DESC;

question: Does delivery time correlate with review score?
sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_delivery_time, AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score FROM olist_orders_dataset o JOIN olist_order_reviews_dataset r ON o.order_id = r.order_id;

question: What's the average freight value by product category?
sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, AVG(oi.freight_value) AS avg_freight_value FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY avg_freight_value DESC;

question: Which payment type is most common?
sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM olist_order_payments_dataset GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1;
